findings.sentence: After right nephrectomy, dactinomycin monotherapy was administered for the left Wilms tumor; however, severe adverse reaction prevented the patient from receiving further chemotherapy.
findings.caveats: Single case; nature of reaction not specified in abstract; BUB1B-MVA child, closest published match to our patient genotype.

findings.system: 38-month-old boy, biallelic BUB1B PCS/MVA, bilateral Wilms tumour, 2019
findings.sentence: The patient survived for 15 months after bilateral nephrectomy without peritoneal relapse, metastasis of Wilms tumor, or the occurrence of rhabdomyosarcoma and maintained a good quality of life while receiving peritoneal dialysis at home.
findings.caveats: Surgical strategy (not a drug) to avoid chemotherapy toxicity; follow-up only 15 months; single case.

note: Drug-agnostic clinical search. Actually used in MVA patients: dactinomycin (BUB1B boy, severe adverse reaction, chemo stopped, bilateral nephrectomy + dialysis gave 15-month remission, PMID 31081598); treosulfan/fludarabine/rabbit ATG RIC HSCT (MVA1 boy, tolerated but graft rejection and death by sepsis day +156, PMID 31053147); ACTH for infantile spasms (refractory, PMID 23916859); cyclosporine after renal transplant (hypertrichosis, PMID 32884756). PMID 31184400 (Pediatr Int 2019) 'Rhabdomyosarcoma with premature chromatid separation-mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome: Reduced-intensity chemotherapy' is the key RMS-in-PCS/MVA report but no abstract is indexed; title suggests chemotherapy was dose-reduced (not verifiable here). Guideline (AACR 2023, PMID 39264246): renal ultrasound every 3 months from birth to age 7 for all MVA, clinical review of systems for RMS, avoid radiation; no drug recommendations. ClinicalTrials.gov: no MVA/BUB1B/PCS studies (API v2 queries returned 0). Evidence is anecdotal (single cases); colcemid-insensitivity (PMID 10877982) suggests BUB1B-deficient cells do not mitotically arrest with spindle poisons, an inference only. Sentences were checked by script against Europe PMC abstracts or PMC HTML at writing time; verified flag left false for the external checker.
